text_to_image_prompt:
Output one image, aspect ratio 1105:1424 (approximately 0.776:1), target canvas 1105 × 1424 pixels.

Create one independent photorealistic studio portrait on a completely seamless pure white #FFFFFF background. Bright soft frontal light, balanced fill, low contrast, faint optical halation, natural pores and fine facial hair, detailed real cotton and knit fabric, realistic 50mm perspective, both eyes sharp and background clean. No room, scenery, props, gradient, vignette, frame, collage, text, branding or watermark. Keep the entire hairstyle inside the frame with a small white margin. One fictional young adult woman, approximately 18–22 years old, with long loose chestnut-brown waves, fair warm skin, brown eyes, soft dark brows, small straight nose, rounded oval face and muted-pink lips; dusty-rose rib-knit open cardigan over ivory scoop-neck tee, tiny silver pendant and relaxed half-smile. Frame a close head-and-shoulders to mid-torso portrait, both shoulders visible, gaze toward camera, subject large in frame; retain the specifically described head angle and pose. Clean lightly flushed natural skin and light everyday makeup, no heavy eyeliner or glossy beauty retouching.
reproduction_note: 文字可复用构图、气质与质感，但随机采样可能改变脸部细节；未验证仅凭文字可达到近乎一致。需要严格锁脸时请同时使用此图作为身份参考。

original_prompt: All images: wholly original adult high-school senior aged 18, reference is only a loose mood cue; invent a new face and identity. Seamless pure white studio background, no props, no text, no logos, no watermark. Bright high-key exposure, soft frontal 50mm portrait lighting, low shadow, subtle halation, natural skin texture, realistic hair strands, believable American high-school character-library photography, modest clothing, no celebrity likeness, no copied facial features or exact outfit. Reference 24 mood: warm brunette with very long hair and casual pink-and-denim styling. Create a new white or mixed-heritage girl with long soft chestnut hair, hazel eyes, gentle open smile, dusty-rose cardigan over a cream ribbed top, small silver pendant. Centered seated-feeling three-quarter portrait with hands out of frame.
